origins.section: A Row Binds When the Plan Leaves It No Slack
A MILP Has No Prices, and Binding Means Zero Slack Even When the Price Is Zero
On a MILP, a Row With Slack Can Still Be the Row That Blocks

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-once-row: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-once-row: "A once row binds exactly when its project is in the plan. That says the project was chosen; it does not say the rule held anything back."
recorded.prompt:q-zero-price: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-zero-price: "Keep the definition (zero slack)". Also: "A binding row with a zero price is the mark of a degenerate LP optimum".
recorded.prompt:q-blocking: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-blocking: "budget_2030 ... refuses 15 of the 25: it is the tightest rule in the plan although it does not bind."

recorded.prompt:q-once-row:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-once-row:b: "A once row binds exactly when its project is in the plan", so zero slack means R7 is in, not out.
recorded.prompt:q-once-row:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-once-row:c: "it does not say the rule held anything back". The page also says a MILP has no prices ("there is no price to read"), so no marginal cost can be read.
recorded.prompt:q-once-row:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-once-row:d: "A once row binds exactly when its project is in the plan", so R7 is in the plan, and the row did not hold it back.
recorded.prompt:q-zero-price:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-zero-price:a: "Some study guides define a binding row as 'zero slack and a nonzero shadow price'. This course does not"
recorded.prompt:q-zero-price:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-zero-price:c: "'binds at price 0' means the plan touches the rule without being pushed by it". The row has slack 0, so it has no room.
recorded.prompt:q-zero-price:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-zero-price:d: The LP table lists rows with slack, e.g. "once slack price 0 16", so not every row has zero slack.
recorded.prompt:q-blocking:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-blocking:a: Section heading and text: "On a MILP, a Row With Slack Can Still Be the Row That Blocks".
recorded.prompt:q-blocking:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-blocking:b: The page sets tolerance at "a small tolerance such as 10^-6", not $40k.
recorded.prompt:q-blocking:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-blocking:d: "budget: no budget row binds. Every year has money left, $50k to $150k."
